ayahOccurrences.text: وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَلَقَدْ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُورًا

ayahOccurrences.text: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ

ayahOccurrences.text: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَٱلزُّبُرِ is in the derivative form: زُبُر
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ز/ب/ر   z–b–r stone, to line the inside of a well with stone
; inscribing on stone, reading, writing, written record; stamina, patience, intelligence. The word زَبور zabūr, meaning Psalter, which is conveniently classified under this root, is a borrowing either from Syriac or Hebrew.

Of this root, 3 forms occur 11 times in the Qur’an:
زَبور zabūr 3 times; زُبُر zubur 7 times andزُبَر zubar 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
زُبُر zubur (2) [pl. of n. زُبْرةٌ zubratun] lumps, large pieces, fractions

(23:53) فَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ but they split their community (or, teachings) [lit. affair] into sects, each faction rejoicing in what they have.

entries.label: زَبور
entries.definitionHtml:
زَبور zabūr [n. pl. زُبُر zubur (1)]

1 [ الزَبور ʾal‐zabūr] Book of Psalms

(21:105) وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى الزَّبُورِ مِنْ بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ أَنَّ الأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحُونَ We wrote/decreed in the Psalms, in addition to/after the [earlier] Scripture/Remembrance that, ‘The earth shall be the inheritance of My righteous servants’

2 generic name for all revealed books, revealed book of divine wisdom, scripture

(3:184) فَإِنْ كَذَّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ جَاءُوا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالزُّبُرِ وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ if they reject you, so have other messengers been rejected before you, even though they came with clear evidence, revealed written texts, and the enlightening Scripture

3 divine record

(54:52) وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى الزُّبُرِ all that they do is [noted] in the divine record.

زُبَر zubar [pl. of n.زُبْرةٌ zubratun] lump, large piece

(18:96) ءَاتُونِي زُبَرَ الْحَدِيدِ bring me lumps of iron!
